stage0058_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$オットー$$
「Haven't been this close since a school field trip.」

stage0058_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Heh... how long ago was that, Captain?」

stage0058_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$オットー$$
「Well, to you it'd seem ages ago.」

stage0058_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$アルト$$
「So this is 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》's first PM's residence ruins?」

stage0058_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$リディ$$
「Our first PM, Ricardo Marcenas... at the
　moment new history, the 《$$宇宙世紀$$》, began...」

stage0058_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$リディ$$
「...was caught in a mysterious explosion at
　the PM's residence, built 200km up, and died」

stage0058_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Same last name as Ensign $$リディ$$...」

stage0058_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カツ$$
「Why'd someone from that family become a pilot?」

stage0058_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$リディ$$
「Being born a man, I felt I should carve
　my own path by my own strength, not my family's.」

stage0058_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Gives me chills, Ensign $$リディ$$!
　I'm borrowing that line!」

stage0058_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'll dig through my own path too!」

stage0058_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Looks like $$アンディ$$'s back on his feet too.」

stage0058_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$n
「Yesterday, they came to my room and
　declared they'd rescue $$ＭＩＸ$$.」

stage0058_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Looks like it'll be a while yet for $$ゼシカ$$...）

stage0058_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The $$宇宙世紀$$, when humanity made great
　strides... it began steeped in blood.」

stage0058_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ブライト$$
「And history since then seems to follow suit...」

stage0058_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The prime example: Zeon Zum Deikun's assassination.」

stage0058_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
（Zeon Zum Deikun...
　advocate of Newtypes, father of Zeon's
　founding... and that person's father...）

stage0058_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Feeling a bit more motivated, $$バナージ$$?」

stage0058_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I only sortied because I had no choice.
　I'm a member of $c too,
　so I'll fulfill my responsibility.」

stage0058_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Responsibility... huh.
　Seems you understand your position.」

stage0058_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...Do you ever have doubts, Mr. $$ダグザ$$?」

stage0058_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「I'm just a part, a cog, in the Federation,
　a vast machine. I just play my given role.」

stage0058_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I... can't be sure of anything anymore...
　Even friend and foe have grown blurred...」

stage0058_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Earth and the colonies are at war, and
　now $$プラント$$'s people want in too...」

stage0058_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Someone as lost as I am all the time
　has no right to bear arms, right?」

stage0058_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Someone like me piloting this, the Unicorn...」

stage0058_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「At least you know you have power, and
　what you can do with it.
　That's why you can fight in $c.」

stage0058_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$バナージ$$
「...I just got swept up by circumstance...」

stage0058_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「At times like that, try bringing things
　down to a more familiar level.」

stage0058_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Don't forget: by test-piloting the Unicorn,
　you changed the fates of those around you.」

stage0058_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「You mean $$オードリー$$, $$タクヤ$$, and $$ミコット$$?」

stage0058_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「That's right.
　You must take responsibility for that.」

stage0058_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「You could also call it protecting them.」

stage0058_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「For now, doubt all you like.
　Since we asked this of you, we'll keep you safe.」

stage0058_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ is after the Unicorn.
　Reading his moves makes countering easier.」

stage0058_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Did you figure out why he's after
　the Unicorn?」

stage0058_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Still unknown for now.
　Same for Mr. $$アルベルト$$, the Unicorn's overseer.」

stage0058_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But it seems he's grown some nerve.
　He's willing to risk his prized Unicorn now.」

stage0058_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「It was his idea to intercept Neo Zeon
　here.」

stage0058_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$バナージ$$
（The ruins of Laplace, the PM's residence...
　Laplace's Box... and $$フル・フロンタル$$'s after it...）

stage0058_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Is something going to happen here...）

stage0058_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「...Don't let it weigh on you too much.」

stage0058_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「The doubt you feel now is a road everyone
　walks... a sign, in other words, of a sane mind.」

stage0058_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「From what I hear, even the famous
　$$アムロ・レイ$$ was the same during the $$一年戦争$$.」

stage0058_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Give me a break, Lt. Colonel $$ダグザ$$.」

stage0058_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I see...
　Then maybe I should've knocked some
　sense into $$バナージ$$ myself.」

stage0058_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「'Sense,' meaning a corrective smack?」

stage0058_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「You're old-fashioned, Dad.
　Trying to move people that way nowadays.」

stage0058_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ブライト$$
「What are you saying, $$ハサウェイ$$.
　Who ever grew up without a few good hits?」

stage0058_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$クラン$$
「Surprising.
　That Captain $$ブライト$$, hailed as a great
　commander, believes in such old-fashioned methods.」

stage0058_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Stay out of this, $$クラン$$.
　It's a world women wouldn't understand.」

stage0058_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「A boys-only world, so to speak!」

stage0058_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「$$サザンカ$$... you're glowing too much...」

stage0058_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Well, that's how it is.
　Don't worry about it too much, $$バナージ$$.」

stage0058_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「...Back when humans had only just begun
　venturing into space, astronauts said they
　felt God's presence, free of Earth's gravity.」

stage0058_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「I hear many astronauts who returned
　devoted themselves to faith afterward.」

stage0058_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Space, that vast dark expanse, must have
　made them sense something beyond us... God.」

stage0058_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But as eras passed, even God's nature changed.」

stage0058_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「To save an Earth at its limits,
　large-scale space migration was essential.」

stage0058_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「And for that, an organization with power
　equal to God's was needed.」

stage0058_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That being the Earth Federation...」

stage0058_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「A merciless god that crushes any who defy it...」

stage0058_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「The PM residence bombing was convenient
　for the Federation. In the name of
　counterterrorism, it let them keep their power.」

stage0058_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Sounds like you're saying the Federation staged it.」

stage0058_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Such things happen sometimes in the adult world.
　But surely none of those involved are still alive.」

stage0058_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$カツ$$
「If the assassination really was staged
　by the Federation, that's some scandal.」

stage0058_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Maybe that truth itself holds the power
　to overturn the current system...
　Laplace's Box... is that it...）

stage0058_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$エマ$$
「I wonder...
　It's certainly a scandalous fact, but...」

stage0058_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$リディ$$
「In this multiverse where countless worlds
　mix, even sharing a name, how much can one
　world's old political drama matter?」

stage0058_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$バナージ$$
（Yeah...
　Now that you mention it, that's true...）

stage0058_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Neo Zeon's pursuit force should be
　catching up to us soon.」

stage0058_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「They must be pretty confused too, us
　stopping to intercept them like this.」

stage0058_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$オズマ$$
「That's the whole point of this plan.
　If we also pin down $$フル・フロンタル$$, their core
　strength, we'll see a path to victory.」

stage0058_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「I'll watch the battle from here and direct everyone.」

stage0058_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「$$バナージ$$, from this position you'll lure
　out $$フル・フロンタル$$.」

stage0058_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「If you're up for it, feel free to turn
　the tables on him with the NT-D.」

stage0058_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$キラ$$
「Leave the fighting to us.
　Just focus on protecting yourself.」

stage0058_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Those two seem to have shaken off yesterday's doubts.」

stage0058_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$オットー$$
「There you are, $$フル・フロンタル$$!」

stage0058_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$アルベルト$$
（If that brat triggers the NT-D in this battle,
　the next coordinates for Laplace's Box will show...）

stage0058_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$アルベルト$$
（Even once $$エタニティ・フラット$$ is complete,
　the world won't end that instant.
　For that too, I must get the Box, no matter what...）

stage0058_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$オットー$$
「Good...! Now if we hit him as planned...」

stage0058_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Neo Zeon troops, incoming from another direction!」

stage0058_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$オットー$$
「They've got a detached unit!」

stage0058_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$キュベレイ$$!
　$$ハマーン・カーン$$'s here!」

stage0058_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「My apologies.
　Even Her Excellency $$ハマーン$$ must take the field...」

stage0058_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't worry, $$フロンタル$$.
　The supreme commander leads the whole army」

stage0058_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「You and I will crush $c...
　but if we misstep, this could be harsher
　than fighting the whole Federation army」

stage0058_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But they've split their forces too.
　This is our chance」

stage0058_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you understand that much, let's go」

stage0058_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（I don't like this, $$フル・フロンタル$$...
　what are you plotting behind that loyal front?）

stage0058_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ハマーン$$
（To cut off future trouble as well,
　I'll destroy the Unicorn he's so fixated on, now）

stage0058_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$'s after the Unicorn too...!」

stage0058_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$エマ$$
「Two separate axes of enemy strength...」

stage0058_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$オズマ$$
「We thought we'd set the trap,
　but they were a step ahead of us...!」

stage0058_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$オットー$$
「Should we pull back here...」

stage0058_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「No, Captain!
　Show weakness and they'll exploit it!」

stage0058_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$オットー$$
「Never thought I'd hear such brave words
　come out of your mouth」

stage0058_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「I, I've fought alongside $c too, you know.
　I've made my own peace with that!」

stage0058_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$アルベルト$$ does have a point there.
　We've no choice but to meet them head-on」

stage0058_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But misjudge the retreat, and there's no undoing it」

stage0058_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Five minutes...!
　If we see no chance of victory by then,
　we pull back, even at a cost!」

stage0058_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「The plan stands...!
　All units, guard the Unicorn and engage!」

stage0058_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Take down $$ハマーン$$ or $$フロンタル$$, the enemy's core,
　and the tide should turn our way!」

stage0058_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Don't worry, $$バナージ$$.
　It's our turn to protect you now」

stage0058_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「There's also $$ハマーン・カーン$$'s presence to think of.
　I can't afford to take too long here...!」

stage0058_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$n
「Is $$フル・フロンタル$$ planning to
　make a move on the Unicorn!」

stage0058_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「What are you doing, $$バナージ・リンクス$$!
　Why won't you activate the NT-D!」

stage0058_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even if you tell me that...!」

stage0058_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is the system sensing $$バナージ$$'s hesitation...!?」

stage0058_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But that's for the best.
　If the NT-D activates now, $$バナージ$$'ll be
　swallowed by the system for sure!」

stage0058_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$アルベルト$$
（Damn it...!
　That brat never does what I want, ever!）

stage0058_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「There's also $$ハマーン・カーン$$'s presence to think of.
　I can't afford to take too long here...!」

stage0058_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$n
「Is $$フル・フロンタル$$ planning to
　make a move on the Unicorn!」

stage0058_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$バナージ$$
「No good!
　I can't shake him off!」

stage0058_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$, fight the $$シナンジュ$$!
　That should trigger the NT-D!」

stage0058_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$オットー$$
「Are you saying it's fine
　if $$バナージ$$ gets swallowed by the system
　and runs amok!」

stage0058_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「Either way, if we leave it,
　he'll just be beaten by the $$シナンジュ$$!
　Better to bet on the one in ten thousand!」

stage0058_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Control the NT-D, $$バナージ$$!」

stage0058_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「It's pathetic, but in the end
　we rely on you!
　So, $$バナージ$$... fight!」

stage0058_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「That machine isn't some killing machine
　built to wipe out Zeon, is it!」

stage0058_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Isn't that exactly why you've fought
　in the Unicorn all along!」

stage0058_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「What turns a machine into power
　is the living heart of the one inside!」

stage0058_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「The one part that can change fate
　and choose for itself... that's the human heart!」

stage0058_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「I'll buy us time!
　You show me your heart can change something!」

stage0058_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「This is my heart...!
　A cog's own wish... the wish I staked on you!」

stage0058_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Clinging to me, are you!」

stage0058_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$アムロ$$
「This... this is the light of the Psycoframe!」

stage0058_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「My consciousness is being swallowed!?」

stage0058_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The Unicorn's Psycoframe
　overlapped $$カミーユ$$'s and $$ハマーン$$'s minds...!」

stage0058_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We saw the same thing...」

stage0058_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$...
　the one inside you smiles with
　such a gentle face...」

stage0058_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Don't get familiar, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$!」

stage0058_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「How dare you barge so bluntly into my heart!
　Know your place, you boor!」

stage0058_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「No, $$ハマーン$$!
　I'm the same as you!
　So...!」

stage0058_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Silence!
　You're just the same as $$シャア$$!」

stage0058_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「You do have real talent, I'll admit!
　But I can't forgive such insolence!」

stage0058_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（A woman after all, $$ハマーン・カーン$$.
　So deep down, you still live clinging
　to $$シャア・アズナブル$$, don't you）

stage0058_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$!
　You're...!!」

stage0058_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's the way, $$バナージ$$」

stage0058_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（I've been tracking the Unicorn's moves
　on the Psyco-Monitor.
　One step closer to the Box, with this）

stage0058_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is as far as it goes...!」

stage0058_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（But I've accomplished my goal）

stage0058_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「To think I'd be led astray...!」

stage0058_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Stop it, $$ハマーン$$!
　We should be able to understand each other!」

stage0058_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is as far as it goes...」

stage0058_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（But I'd already accomplished my goal）

stage0058_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Further combat is too dangerous!
　All units, fall back!」

stage0058_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$フロンタル$$
（But I'd already accomplished my goal）

stage0058_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「The Unicorn, at least, ends here...!」

stage0058_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「We settle this here, $$バナージ$$!
　You and I got too close!」

stage0058_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so, there must be an answer besides fighting!」

stage0058_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「If that could be found,
　this war wouldn't have happened!」

stage0058_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't give up on thinking, $$マリーダ$$!
　Throw away the possibility, and it's over!」

stage0058_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「You think words like that will stop me!」

stage0058_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$バナージ$$
「A child...!?
　What is this image...!」

stage0058_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is that... you, $$マリーダ$$...」

stage0058_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$バナージ$$
（This... this is just too sad...）

stage0058_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（Kindness alone can't save a person...
　it can't erase sin or filth...）

stage0058_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$!!
　I'm coming!!」

stage0058_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$フラスト$$
「It's impossible, Captain!
　Not from this position!」

stage0058_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain!
　A Neo Zeon ship is closing on this sector!」

stage0058_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$モニカ$$
「This is... the $$レウルーラ$$!」

stage0058_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Tch!
　He prioritized us over the Federation fleet!」

stage0058_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$シャア$$
「Hear me, $c.
　I am Neo Zeon's Supreme Commander, $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0058_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$シャア$$
「I've come here to negotiate with you all.」

stage0058_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$シャア$$
「I say again.
　I'm not here to fight you.
　I've come to offer a ceasefire.」

stage0058_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$シャア$$
「If you'll accept my request to talk,
　I'll wait at Point 1737, three days from now.」

stage0058_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「What are you playing at, $$シャア$$...?」

stage0058_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$シャア$$
「This is the answer I give as Supreme Commander.
　If you object, I'll hear it.」

stage0058_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$シャア$$
「$c...
　I'm counting on your good judgment.」

stage0058_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$... why now, of all things...」

stage0058_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「A peace talk with $c...
　It doesn't seem to be one between
　the Earth Federation and Neo Zeon.」

stage0058_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ブライト$$
「He showed himself, in person.
　Knowing him, that's hard to imagine.」

stage0058_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So we have no choice but to go...」

stage0058_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This could be a major turning point...
　We should link up with the ground forces too.」

stage0058_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Laplace's Program...
　What... is this...?」

stage0058_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$バナージ$$
「These coordinates...
　Could this be... Dakar...?」

stage0058_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$アルベルト$$
「What are you doing, $$バナージ・リンクス$$!
　Why won't you activate the NT-D!」

stage0058_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even if you tell me that...!」

stage0058_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is the system sensing $$バナージ$$'s hesitation...!?」

stage0058_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But that's for the best.
　If the NT-D activates now, $$バナージ$$'ll be
　swallowed by the system for sure!」

stage0058_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$アルベルト$$
（Damn it...!
　That brat never does what I want, ever!）

stage0058_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Failing again and again before the captain...!
　What in the world am I doing!!」

stage0058_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「You're too serious, $$アンジェロ$$.
　That'll be the end of you.」

stage0058_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Captain!
　We can't hold much longer!」

stage0058_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Making it work anyway is what skill's for!」

stage0058_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Fall back, $$ジンネマン$$.
　I'll take it from here.」

stage0058_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Guard the home $$マリーダ$$ must return to.」

stage0058_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「...Understood.
　$$ガランシェール$$, falling back.」

stage0058_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's how it is, $$マリーダ$$.
　Come back alive, no matter what.」

stage0058_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$フラスト$$
「Captain!
　We can't hold much longer!」

stage0058_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Making it work anyway is what skill's for!」

stage0058_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Fall back, $$ジンネマン$$.
　I'll take it from here.」

stage0058_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Do you mean to cost $$マリーダ$$ her way home?」

stage0058_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Understood.
　$$ガランシェール$$, falling back.」

stage0058_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ギルボア$$
「This is as far as I go!
　I'm counting on the rest of you!」

stage0058_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「The Unicorn, at least, ends here...!」

stage0058_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「We settle this here, $$バナージ$$!
　You and I got too close!」

stage0058_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so, there must be an answer besides fighting!」

stage0058_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「If that could be found,
　this war wouldn't have happened!」

stage0058_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't give up on thinking, $$マリーダ$$!
　Throw away the possibility, and it's over!」

stage0058_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「You think words like that will stop me!」

stage0058_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「A child...!?
　What is this image...!」

stage0058_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is that... you, $$マリーダ$$...」

stage0058_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$バナージ$$
（This... this is just too sad...）

stage0058_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$マリーダ$$
（Kindness alone can't save a person...
　it can't erase sin or filth...）

stage0058_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$マリーダ$$!!
　I'm coming!!」

stage0058_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$フラスト$$
「It's impossible, Captain!
　Not from this position!」

stage0058_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ダグザ$$
（Heh... if I had a son of my own,
　maybe I'd have felt like this...）

stage0058_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ダグザ$$
（Survive, $$バナージ$$...!
　You've still got your whole life ahead!）

stage0058_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$バナージ$$
「How dare you, to Mr. $$ダグザ$$!」

stage0058_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is what war is, $$バナージ$$.
　You and I, we're both part of it.」

stage0058_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「A fine sensibility.
　A pilot who can feel others' lives grows strong.」

stage0058_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「This Gundam...!
　Turning human will into power!?」

stage0058_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That person...!
　A different kind of strength than $$フル・フロンタル$$'s...!」

stage0058_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「You'll pay the price
　for peering into someone's heart!」

stage0058_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$バナージ$$
「So what if I did!?
　Mr. $$ダグザ$$ was killed because of you!」

stage0058_04:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Forcing your own logic on everyone like that!
　How much longer will you keep this up!?」

stage0058_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Admit it, $$ハマーン$$!
　You're only fighting because $$シャア$$ dragged you into it!」

stage0058_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You of all people should know!
　That the world can change
　without resorting to war!」

stage0058_04:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「How pathetic!
　So you'll stand with the establishment
　and force Spacenoids to endure it!?」

stage0058_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Cut $$シャア$$ loose, $$ハマーン$$!
　If you're going to fight, fight on your own will!」

stage0058_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「I won't allow any more insults!
　You'll pay for this, $$アムロ・レイ$$!」

stage0058_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Shall we settle this, $$アムロ$$!」

stage0058_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Trying to imitate $$シャア$$, $$フル・フロンタル$$!?」

stage0058_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「In time, you'll come to understand
　what my words mean.」

stage0058_04:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$!
　You'd refuse to understand each other and fight!?」

stage0058_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「If you think that was my true heart,
　you're gravely mistaken! Don't read minds!」

stage0058_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Why refuse to admit your own heart like this!?
　All that awaits down that road is ruin!」

stage0058_04:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Spare me your knowing tone!
　Before that, you barged into my heart
　uninvited. I'll make you pay for it!」

stage0058_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Must we really fight, $$マリーダ$$!?」

stage0058_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Accept reality, $$バナージ$$!
　You and I were fated to end up here!」
